description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' Newtonsoft.Json serialization support, including serialization, deep copying, and handling of native JSON types, using xUnit testing framework.

classes.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodecTests
classes.description: Unit tests for Newtonsoft.Json serialization support in Orleans.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the serializer builder to add Newtonsoft.Json serializer with support for types marked with a specific attribute.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Creates sample instance of MyNewtonsoftJsonClass for testing.

methods.name: MaxSegmentSizes
methods.description: Defines maximum segment sizes for testing serialization segments.

methods.name: TestValues
methods.description: Provides test instances including null, empty, and large string properties.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonDeepCopyTyped
methods.description: Tests deep copying of strongly typed Newtonsoft.Json objects.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonDeepCopyUntyped
methods.description: Tests deep copying via untyped interface.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization (round trip) through the codec.

methods.name: CanSerializeNativeJsonTypes
methods.description: Verifies native Newtonsoft.Json types like JArray and JObject can be serialized and deserialized correctly.

classes.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodecCopierTests
classes.description: Unit tests for deep copying support of Newtonsoft.Json objects in Orleans.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the serializer with Newtonsoft.Json support for types marked with a specific attribute.

methods.name: CreateCopier
methods.description: Creates a deep copier for MyNewtonsoftJsonClass.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Creates sample MyNewtonsoftJsonClass instances for testing.

methods.name: TestValues
methods.description: Provides various test instances, including null, empty, and large string properties.

methods.name: CanCopyNativeJsonTypes
methods.description: Verifies deep copying Native Json types like JArray and JObject.
